title: Evaluate simplification and merging of equal subexpressions in the flat program of symbolic user functions
author: Claude-JG
description: revision2026c step RG12.49.1: x*0, x*1, x+0 and numbers; equal subexpressions recorded twice, e.g. cos(q[2]) written two times, are two nodes and computed twice; measure the recorded models, propose how and where, the impact on the implementation and on D18.
